visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four young women wearing Rakuten Monkeys baseball-style jerseys stand in an indoor room with bright fluorescent lighting. They wear red cartoon vein emojis on their foreheads, crossing their arms and staring intensely at the camera with grumpy, pouting facial expressions and furrowed brows. (2) The four women synchronize their movements perfectly, lifting their hands to their heads to form "horns" with their index fingers while maintaining serious, pouting expressions and squinting their eyes to emphasize the playful "irritated" theme through their physical body language and posture. (3) The camera cuts to a much wider shot revealing a group of eleven cheerleaders in identical white and red uniforms standing in a locker room environment. A blonde woman stands at the front center, smiling brightly while the others behind her mimic the previous horn gesture and arm-crossing sequence. (4) The entire group continues the rhythmic dance together while pink flower and white cloud emojis float across the screen. The sequence concludes with cartoon curse symbols appearing over their heads as they strike a final pose with varied hand gestures and facial expressions.
